Year
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
First Call Q4 consensus estimate was $0.62 a share.

The statutory combined ratio, on a core operating income basis, was 103.2 percent, down from 106.7 percent in the prior quarter, primarily reflecting favorable reserve development in the personal automobine business and expense savings.
The ratio for the full year was 106.3 percent.
1996 Q4 net income included a net acquisition-related charge of $31.5 million after tax related to the acquisition of the property-casualty operations of Aetna Inc.
1996 Q4 net income also includes investment portfolio gains of $31.6 million after tax.
1996 Q4 operating earnings were $261.6 million or $0.65 a share vs $111.9 million or $0.38 a share a year ago.

The 1996 full year core operating earnings reached $801.5 million, which consists of $720.7 million from the combined operations for the last three quarters and $80.8 million from Travelers only for the first quarter.
1996 operating earnings were $2.17 a share compared with $1.27 a year ago.
1996 net income includes net acquisition-related charges of $422.5 million and investment portfolio gains of $11.5 million.
Combined net written premiums for the quarter were $1.801 billion compared with $1.865 billion in 1995.
Earnings for the quarter and year are not comparable to those of 1995 because the results of Aetna Casualty and Surety are included from April 2, 1996 only.
